case_insensitive.description: If true, apply case-insensitive matching to include/exclude patterns.

event_filter.description: List of event names to include in output (e.g., 'created', 'modified').

exclude_patterns.description: List of regex patterns for paths to exclude.

extended_regex.description: If true, interpret patterns as extended regular expressions.

follow_links.description: If true, follow symbolic links to directories.

include_patterns.description: List of regex patterns for paths to include.

latency.description: Latency in seconds; must be ≥ 0.1. Controls event batching delay.

monitor.description: Monitor type to use. Valid values: 'FSEvents', 'kqueue', 'inotify', 'poll'. Empty uses platform default.

utc_timestamp.description: If true, print timestamps in UTC; otherwise print local time.

watch_paths.description: List of file or directory paths to monitor.
